**Smart Plant Monitoring and Automatic Irrigation System**

**Project Description**

The Smart Plant Monitoring and Automatic Irrigation System is an Arduino-based system designed to monitor the environmental conditions required for healthy plant growth.

The system uses multiple sensors to monitor soil moisture, temperature, humidity, light intensity, and plant height/growth. An Arduino Uno collects and processes the sensor data and displays the information on a 16×2 LCD with I2C interface.

When the soil moisture falls below the required level, the Arduino automatically activates a relay-controlled water pump to provide water to the plant. Once sufficient moisture is detected, the pump is switched OFF.

The system can be used for different types of plants, including indoor plants, garden plants, nursery plants, greenhouse plants, and agricultural plants. The moisture and environmental thresholds can be adjusted according to the specific plant.

**Components Required**

**No.	    Component	      Quantity	    Function**

1	Arduino Uno	                       1	Main controller  
2	16×2 LCD with I2C module	1	Displays sensor readings  
3	DHT11	                                   1	Temperature & humidity measurement  
4	HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor	1	Plant height/growth monitoring  
5	Soil Moisture Sensor	            1	Measures soil moisture  
6	LDR Sensor Module          	1	Measures light intensity  
7	1-Channel 5V Relay Module	1	Controls water pump  
8	12V DC Water Pump	            1	Automatic irrigation  
9	Breadboard	                        1	Circuit assembly  
10	Jumper Wires          	As required	Connections  
11	12V DC Power Supply	1	Pump power  
12	USB/5V supply	            1	Arduino power  
13	Water container	            1	Stores irrigation water  
14	Water tube	                        1	Transfers water to plant

**Working Applications**

## 🌱 1\. **Soil Moisture Monitoring**

The soil moisture sensor continuously checks the water content of the soil.

Dry soil → Pump ON

Sufficient moisture → Pump OFF

## 🌡️ 2\. **Temperature Monitoring**

The DHT11 measures the surrounding temperature. This information can be used to identify whether the plant environment is within the desired range.

## 💧 3\. **Humidity Monitoring**

DHT11 also measures atmospheric humidity around the plant.

## ☀️ 4\. **Light Monitoring**

The LDR detects the available light intensity. This helps monitor whether the plant is receiving adequate light.

## 📏 5\. **Plant Growth Monitoring**

The HC-SR04 measures the distance between the sensor and the plant. Changes in measured distance can be used to track plant growth over time.

## 💦 6\. **Automatic Irrigation**

The Arduino controls the relay according to soil moisture.

Dry → Relay ON → Pump ON → Water supplied

Moist → Relay OFF → Pump OFF

## 📟 7**. Real-Time Display**

The LCD displays important parameters such as:

Temp: 28°C  Hum: 62%  
Soil: DRY   Ht: 15cm

 **Application**

This system can be used for:

🌱 Indoor plant monitoring

🌿 Home gardens

🌾 Agricultural fields

🪴 Nurseries

🌳 Young tree monitoring

🌱 Greenhouse plants

🌿 Medicinal plants

🌸 Flowering plants

🌾 Crop monitoring

💧 Automatic irrigation systems

 **Advantage**

The important feature is that the system is not limited to one particular plant.

Different plants require different amounts of water, temperature, humidity and light. Therefore, the Arduino program can be configured with different threshold values depending on the plant being monitored.

Example

Plant Type	      Moisture Requirement

Indoor plant	            Moderate  
Flowering plant	Moderate/High  
Vegetable plant	Moderate/High  
Nursery plant	            Depends on plant

 **Project Objective**

“To develop a low-cost automated system that monitors important plant-growth parameters and provides water automatically according to the moisture requirement of the plant.”
